fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (GOOG) share price $279.20 on November 18, market cap $3.43 trillion, down 12.96% monthly and 3.72% over 52 weeks.
fields.summary_ko.1: Despite 24% Q2 revenue increase and 82% Google Cloud growth rate, share price plummeted as 2026 capex guidance raised to maximum $205 billion and free cash flow turned negative.
fields.summary_ko.2: RiverPark Large Growth Fund evaluates Alphabet's Search, Cloud, and YouTube franchises as solid with share price recording lowest multiple since 2019.
